title: Book One · Chapter 45: A Place for Mum's Work
story:
By the end of another month, Mum has five sewing jobs. They are in her work box. Each job has a name and a date. Some customers brought loose buttons with their clothes. Each set goes in its own little bag. The old sewing box is getting full.

She spreads her notebook on the table after dinner.

“I need this end clear for two hours tomorrow,” she says. “And I need good light.”

Ronan looks at his map. He put it there on Tuesday. He left it there for several days.

“Can I use this end for my map? Can you sew at the other end?”

“Sometimes. But a long sleeve needs the whole board. Then I need both ends.”

“Shall I move my tools?” Dad asks. “Yes, please,” Mum says. “I need that space for these folded clothes.” The screw lids cover part of the table.

Dad puts the first lid in his box. Ronan doesn't move his paper yet. He wants to keep drawing at the table. But Mum needs that place to sew. He leaves his hands on his paper.

Mum sees his face. She still needs her work place. She clears that end.

“You can keep the map on the board. You can put it on your bed in the evening. At bedtime, it goes by the wall.”

“What about my homework?”

“You'll have the table before dinner. My work time is after dinner.”

They try the plan the next day. Ronan does his sums at the table. Mum cooks beside him. Dad comes home late and washes at the yard tap. They finish dinner quickly. Mum wants to start work. The sleeve is beside the window.

After dinner, Ronan wipes his place. He accidentally wipes water over one corner of the map. He lifts it at once. Only a small blank part is damp.

“I need somewhere dry now,” he says.

Dad gets two old flat boards from behind the bed. Dad asked Mrs Lan about these boards. “Yes, you can use those boards,” Mrs Lan told him. One board has a rough edge. Dad keeps that one away from Ronan. He makes the edge smooth first.

Together, they make a low drawing place across two storage boxes. It isn't a new table, and Ronan can't climb on it. They put the map and two books on it. The boards stay flat.

Mum looks over. “Does it leave room for the door?”

They move one box. Mum carries the sleeve past the boards. The cloth does not brush against them.

For the next hour, the room has three quiet jobs. Mum sews. Dad checks a small hand tool. Ronan redraws a wet corner. The black cat looks through the window and chooses not to join them.

Then Ronan tries to write entrance. He needs help with the letters. He gets as far as the middle and stops.

“Mum?”

“One minute. I'm counting stitches.”

He waits. The word stays unfinished. He wants Mum to answer now. But she is still counting. He leaves her to count. He does not call her name again.

Dad writes the word on a scrap. Ronan copies it. Mum finishes her line and looks up.

“Did you find it?”

“Yes.”

“Good. Show me after this seam.”

At bedtime, the map goes upright by the wall. The sewing goes into separate cloth bags. Every bag has a label. Dad closes the blue toolbox. Each person puts the work away. Mum had time to sew. Ronan had time for his map. Dad finished with his tools, too.

“Can I keep these boards here tomorrow?” Ronan asks.

“Yes,” Mum says. “Keep the walking space clear, too.”

He puts his shoes beside the door. Dad moves a bag with his foot. Mum laughs. “Leave room for the door, too. It still needs room to open.”

Ronan opens the door all the way. Nothing blocks it. Then he climbs into bed.
studyGuide:
---

重点表达：stitches＝针脚；counting＝数数；upright＝竖直的；clear＝清空的。

理解问题：

1. Mum 为什么需要新的工作安排？
2. 家里怎样在小房间中为她腾出工作位置？
